trial_court: VI Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal District, Cyberabad, C.C.No.839 of 2017
case_name: Konda Raghu Babu vs Smt.Konda Or Koti Radhika
facts_of_case: The petitioners subjected the respondent to cruelty for her failure to meet the illegal demand of dowry. She lodged a report with the police alleging harassment and obtained an FIR. Investigation was conducted and a charge sheet was filed.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging harassment to prove the same.
legal_principles.held: Section 498-A IPC is clear that when the wife meted out any harassment in the hands of the husband or relatives and they are liable for punishment, if it is in connection with payment of dowry.

legal_principles.principle: A divorce deed executed by the parties can be considered as evidence of a legally valid divorce.
legal_principles.held: Learned counsel for the petitioners also drawn the attention of the Court to the divorce deed dated 21.11.2011 whereby both parties dissolved their marriage by mutual consent and reason for obtain the divorce is also mentioned.

outcome.final_order: The proceedings were quashed as the marriage between Nagaraju and the respondent was subsisting, making her not entitled to lodge a report with the police.

keywords: Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act
